explication: K8M is an AI-assisted Kubernetes management console. Users sign in, select a connected cluster, and use the web console or APIs to inspect and manage Kubernetes resources; backend controllers call the Kubernetes client and return results. Major documented branches include AI diagnosis, Helm, inspections, event forwarding, MCP, and API keys. Relationships for unsampled features are documented rather than inferred from module names; source-level detail is limited to the excerpts and SOURCE INDEX.
